aggregation: one unit per held-out context, drug, and dose; drug-cluster inference; all eligible A2e units retained

axes.artifact_gate: if an association is absorbed by sequencing-depth or true-effect controls, classify it as a measurement/sampling artifact rather than a biological generalizability failure
axes.direction: lower treated-cell support predicts lower STATE performance
axes.levels: five equal-count levels fixed by treated-cell count, high support to low support, with stable context/drug/dose tie breaking
axes.prospective_feature: negative log1p of treated-cell count; matched-control count is an adjusted covariate

axes.direction: lower dose predicts lower STATE performance because weaker responses approach the measurement floor
axes.levels: the three pre-existing balanced dose levels; no data-dependent binning
axes.mechanism_gate: if held-out true effect magnitude absorbs dose, reattribute the mechanism to response magnitude and retain dose only as its experimentally set proxy
axes.prospective_feature: ordered administered concentration 5.0, 0.5, 0.05 uM within each drug and context

axes.direction: the A2e degradation should remain directionally consistent under the official ST-SE representation and last-checkpoint sensitivity tables
axes.interpretation: this is a robustness interaction, not an input-side axis by itself; discordance limits family-level transport but does not retroactively alter the ST-HVG primary result
axes.levels: paired official score rows on the identical eligible Tahoe perturbations and contexts wherever release coverage permits
axes.prospective_feature: released ST-HVG versus ST-SE model family and best versus last checkpoint

axis_name: Tahoe sampling-support, dose, and model-family secondary axes
confirmation_set: the external Tahoe chemical confirmation set, source-independent from Replogle discovery
deduplication: one normalized context-drug-dose row; technical plates aggregated before scoring; paired family rows matched on exact context and perturbation
direction: lower sampling support and lower dose predict lower performance; the primary A2e direction should remain consistent across released model-family sensitivities
distance_metric: A3 negative log1p treated cells, A5 negative log dose in uM, A6 paired categorical interaction
error_spending_plan: secondary estimates are descriptive and fully enumerated; none replaces or rescues the A2e primary look, and no repeated peeking is permitted
family_role: mechanistically plausible axes required by the discovery brief; descriptive confirmation with drug-block bootstrap confidence intervals, not substitutes for the A2e primary look
gene_set: the same 879 prospectively and uniquely mapped ST-HVG output genes as A2e for A3/A5; official full released score representation for A6, explicitly labeled non-identical when a paired 879-gene table is unavailable
hypothesis_source: mechanistically plausible controls and candidate axes explicitly required by the audit brief and candidate ledger before Tahoe target access
inclusion_exclusion: identical frozen A2e set of 199 complete drug triplets across five held-out cell lines; vehicle excluded; no outcome-dependent exclusions
level_rule: A3 five stable equal-count levels from high to low treated-cell support; A5 fixed 5.0, 0.5, and 0.05 uM levels; A6 paired released family/checkpoint categories
metric: signed Spearman correlation over the same 879 genes for A3/A5; official signed-LFC Spearman-compatible released score for A6 sensitivity
multiplicity: report every estimate and interval; do not promote a secondary result to the preregistered A2e primary claim and do not tune thresholds after scoring
normalization: official Tahoe metadata counts, administered uM dose, and official cell-eval scores; no held-out performance is used to construct an axis
power_plan: single secondary look after the A2e primary score is materialized; 10,000 drug-block bootstrap draws; no threshold or subgroup revision
prospective_features: A3 negative log1p treated-cell count; A5 administered concentration ordered 5.0 to 0.05 uM; A6 released representation/checkpoint family identifiers
sample_size_target: A3/A5 use all 2,985 planned A2e units from 199 drug clusters; A6 reports all paired eligible official score rows and treats incomplete pairing as a release limitation
scope: prospective secondary axes evaluated on the frozen Tahoe A2e confirmation set without changing its examples, features, or primary test
shared_metric: signed Spearman correlation over the same prospectively mapped 879 genes
shared_resampling: 10,000 drug-cluster bootstrap draws, preserving the five contexts and three doses for each sampled drug
shared_unit: held-out Tahoe cell line x drug x dose among the 2,985 A2e units
success_criteria: report every axis estimate and drug-block 95% interval; call A3/A5 directional degradation only when the preregistered coefficient interval is below zero and endpoint ordering agrees; classify nuisance-absorbed A3 as artifact and magnitude-absorbed A5 as a proxy; use A6 only as sensitivity
target_access_state: drafted before any Tahoe STATE prediction or real target DE output was read
unit: held-out Tahoe cell line x chemical drug x dose condition
